column1: # Character data for normalize.rs, from Python 3.14.4 unicodedata (Unicode 16.0.0) and remove_symbols_and_diacritics in github.com/huggingface/open_asr_leaderboard normalizer/normalizer.py at commit 6a3e6d4e3ec28b81aa5d9a15a5467e13e2b98622 (Apache-2.0), generated by scripts/gen_tables.py
# c <first code point> <class> sets the class up to the next c line. z space, d decimal digit, w other letter or number, n nonspacing mark, m other mark, s symbol, p punctuation, o other

# r <code point> <code points...> is what the symbol and diacritic removal turns a character into (its compatibility decomposition, cleaned) where that differs from its class's rule. r <first>-<last> <code point> covers a run that all give that code point, and r <first>-<last> +<code point> a run that counts up from it. Hangul syllables are computed
# l <first>[-<last>] is a run of characters that str.lower() changes
